mapper.sql: pilgrimage_id, user_id, course_id, status, started_at, completed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pilgrimage (user_id, course_id, status, started_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, 'IN_PROGRESS', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pilgrimage WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY started_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE pilgrimage SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = COALESCE(completed_at, NOW()) WHERE pilgrimage_id = #{pilgrimageId}
UPDATE pilgrimage SET status = 'IN_PROGRESS', completed_at = NULL WHERE pilgrimage_id = #{pilgrimageId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.region_id, r.name AS region_name, c.course_id, c.name AS course_name, p.pilgrimage_id, p.status AS pilgrimage_status, cs.position, cs.course_site_id, COALESCE(i18n.name, s.name) AS site_name, st.stamp_id, st.mission_verified_at AS completed_at, st.user_sentence, st.photo_key FROM pilgrimage p JOIN course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id JOIN region r ON r.region_id = c.region_id JOIN course_site cs ON cs.course_id = c.course_id JOIN site s ON s.site_id = cs.site_id LEFT JOIN site_i18n i18n ON i18n.site_id = s.site_id AND i18n.locale = 'ko' LEFT JOIN stamp st ON st.pilgrimage_id = p.pilgrimage_id AND st.completed_course_site_id = cs.course_site_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.sort_no, r.region_id, c.sort_no, c.course_id, cs.position
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pilgrimage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'COMPLETED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stamp st JOIN pilgrimage p ON p.pilgrimage_id = st.pilgrimage_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND st.verify_status = 'COMPLETED'
